body.prompt: A Korean office worker in his forties sitting alone at his desk late at night in a dark empty office, looking down at his phone with a heavy, tired expression, rows of empty desks behind him, only his desk lamp on, the phone screen shows nothing readable. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey night palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
